text:
Predicates:
RosesGivenOut(x) ::: roses are given out during x.
OnTV(x) ::: x is on TV.
Bachelor(x) ::: x is the Bachelor.
PortraysRealLives(x) ::: x portrays the lives of real people.
RealityTVShow(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
Time(x, y) ::: x occurs at time y.
Day(x, y) ::: x occurs on day y.
MondaysAt8pm(x) ::: x occurs on Mondays at 8 pm.

Premises:
∃x (Day(x, monday) ∧ Time(x, 8pm) ∧ OnTV(x) ∧ RosesGivenOut(x)) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀x (RosesGivenOut(x) ∧ OnTV(x) → Bachelor(x)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (Bachelor(x) → PortraysRealLives(x)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (PortraysRealLives(x) → RealityTVShow(x)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTVShow(breakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.

Conclusion:
RosesGivenOut(breakingBad) → (Day(breakingBad, monday) ∧ Time(breakingBad, 8pm)) ::: If roses are given out during Breaking Bad, then it is on Monday at 8 pm.
